mapper.select: SELECT category, expense_type, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM transaction_history WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND transaction_type = 'EXPENSE' AND transaction_at >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL #{monthsAgo} MONTH) AND transaction_at < DATE_ADD( DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL #{monthsAgo} MONTH), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND transaction_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY category, expense_type
